items.title: ASE-26: a curriculum for agentic software engineering as a discipline

summary.zh: 本文提出ASE-26课程框架，面向Agent软件工程教学。研究发现，专业软件工程师的工作正从编写代码转向指挥Agent，这一转变已经有数年的实证支持（Claude Code自动化率79%）。论文设计了21模块的本科课程，强调实践纪律和Agent协作下的工作评估方法，认为行业缺乏的不是更好的模型，而是结构化的从业者能力。课程设计目标是培养能适应不同模型时代的通用能力。
summary.en: This paper introduces ASE-26, a comprehensive undergraduate curriculum for agentic software engineering. The work addresses the empirical shift toward AI-directed development: Anthropic data shows 79% automation in...

items.title: SkillAdaptor: Self-Adapting Skills for LLM Agents from Trajectories

summary.zh: SkillAdaptor提出一个训练无关的Step级Agent技能适配框架。针对现有方法无法精确定位失败责任的问题，该框架通过显式失败归因识别第一个可执行的错误步骤，在冻结骨干的前提下对候选技能进行有针对性的更新。在WebShop、PinchBench等多个基准上评测，相比无技能和技能适配基线有+1.5到+1.8的单指标改进。展示了Step级归因对可审计的Agent技能维护的重要性。
summary.en: SkillAdaptor presents a training-free step-level skill adaptation framework for LLM agents. Existing methods coarsely attribute failures to trajectories or sessions, producing unstable updates. This work identifies the...

items.title: TimeSage-MT: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Evaluating Agentic Time Series Reasoning

summary.zh: TimeSage-MT引入首个多轮Agent时间序列推理基准，包含240个任务跨8个真实领域。现有基准只评测单步任务如预测和异常检测，而实际应用中Agent需要在多轮对话中逐步积累证据。基准从基础探索到决策导向的分析，揭示LLM在记忆、不确定性处理和域知识决策上的显著缺陷。为Agent系统提供严格的评估基础。
summary.en: TimeSage-MT introduces the first multi-turn benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on time series reasoning. With 240 tasks and 2,680 dialogue turns across 8 domains, it moves beyond single-step forecasting to multi-turn...

items.title: Dive into Ambiguity: A*-Inspired Multi-Agents Commonsense Obfuscation Attack on LLM Prompts

summary.zh: 本文提出A*启发的对抗攻击框架，用于生成语义保持但模糊化的prompt。通过动态语义离散度系数平衡保守编辑和激进混淆，采用反向模拟退火策略。论文还引入代理机制标注揭示对抗机制，提供可解释的反向优化。理论证明prompt重写遵循收缩递归，当系数减小时导致语义崩溃。在多个LLM上达到更高的攻击成功率。
summary.en: This work presents an A*-inspired Factual Error Induction Framework for generating semantically aligned yet obfuscated prompts. A hierarchical rewrite strategy uses dynamic semantic dispersion coefficient to balance...

items.title: Self-Healing Agentic Orchestrators for Reliable Tool-Augmented Large Language Model Systems

summary.zh: 自修复Agent编排器将可靠性视为有界运行时控制问题。在Tool-augmented LLM系统中，故障来自工具超时、参数畸形、上下文陈旧等编排层问题。该方法将可观测故障信号映射到推断故障类别，在显式预算约束下选择恢复行动。在100任务故障注入基准上，自修复达成98.8%成功率（对比仅重试94.5%）。验证器引导的恢复将无声故障从高频降至0%。
summary.en: Self-healing agentic orchestrators treat reliability as bounded runtime control. Tool-augmented LLM systems fail not just from model errors but orchestration-layer issues: tool timeouts, malformed arguments, stale...

items.title: Early Diagnosis of Wasted Computation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems via Failure-Aware Observability

summary.zh: 本文提出故障感知可观测框架，诊断多Agent LLM系统中的计算浪费。Tool-using Agent系统通过模型令牌、工具调用、重试和代码执行消耗计算，但单纯的终点评估无法定位轨迹失败的具体点。框架映射故障模式到在线迹象：工具可靠性、执行恢复、编排循环等。在GAIA验证集上，分析揭示不同失败机制如证据不足、重复动作循环、最大步数终止。
summary.en: A failure-aware observability framework diagnoses wasted computation in multi-agent LLM traces. Tool-using systems spend tokens, tools calls, retries, and code execution before producing answers; endpoint evaluation...

items.title: Recognize Your Orchestrator: An Entropy Dynamics Perspective for LLM Multi-Agent Systems

summary.zh: 从熵动力学角度分析LLM多Agent系统的中央编排器脆弱性。论文提出均值场熵动力学框架，将编排过程建模为任务分解和累积上下文负荷相互竞争的系统。引入逆向工作流生成(IWG)合成流程可验证的高复杂度基准。熵模型拟合经验轨迹，揭示系统稳定性和性能崩溃的物理可解释参数。核心发现"推理陷阱"：推理能力强的模型在编排任务中频繁失败。
summary.en: Analyzing LLM multi-agent systems through Mean-Field Entropy Dynamics reveals fragility of centralized orchestration. Task resolution and cumulative context loading compete as opposing forces. Inverse Workflow...

items.title: Can LLM Agents Sustain Long-Horizon Organizational Dynamics?

summary.zh: TaskWeave框架支持LLM Agent进行年级别的长地平线组织模拟。传统多Agent框架难以维持结构化组织中的连贯行为，其中目标通过层级传播、任务依赖先前执行、工件跨轨迹积累。TaskWeave采用层级结构，通过Formulate-Partition-Diagnose-Align循环维护规划状态，通过依赖感知迹象记忆实现执行接地。在为期一年的IT公司模拟中展示了连贯的长地平线组织动态。
summary.en: TaskWeave enables LLM agents to sustain coherent behavior in structured organizations over long horizons (year-long simulations). Multi-agent frameworks struggle when goals propagate hierarchically, tasks depend on...

items.title: SkillRevise: Improving LLM-Authored Agent Skills via Trace-Conditioned Skill Revision

summary.zh: SkillRevise通过执行接地的框架迭代改进初始Agent技能。冷启动设置下，现有自进化方法难以操作（只有一个初始不完美技能）。SkillRevise从执行证据诊断缺陷，从通用记忆检索修复原则，应用执行锚定的编辑。通过重新执行和测量实用性保留最优版本。跨三个基准五个LLM，基础Agent成功率从36.05%提升到61.63%。修订技能展示强跨模型转移性。
summary.en: SkillRevise improves LLM-authored agent skills via execution-grounded iterative refinement. Cold-start settings (single imperfect initial skill) challenge existing self-evolving methods. The framework diagnoses skill...

items.title: TravelEval: A Comprehensive Benchmarking Framework for Evaluating LLM-Powered Travel Planning Agents

summary.zh: TravelEval提出旅行规划Agent的综合基准框架。现有基准过度强调约束符合性，忽视时空成本等多维质量。TravelEval引入六维评估框架（准确性、符合性、时间性、空间性、经济性、实用性），使用真实住宿定价和跨城交通数据，通过仿真模拟完整旅行计划。评测显示LLM在全局优化多维规划上力不从心，特别是时空推理和预算符合性。
summary.en: TravelEval introduces a comprehensive benchmark for LLM-powered travel planning agents. Existing benchmarks overemphasize constraint compliance, missing multi-dimensional qualities like spatio-temporal cost. TravelEval...

items.title: Leyline: KV Cache Directives for Agentic Inference

summary.zh: Leyline为Agent推理引入KV缓存指令原语。聊天机器人工作负载假设缓存单调增长，但Agent通过策略编辑打破这一假设：失败工具调用重试、陈旧输出丢弃、轨迹转向。Leyline分离编辑内容和位置正确性保留，声明式指令通过特定架构核心实现，通过闭形式RoPE旋转纠正恢复注意力数学。Splice核心提升11.2 pp缓存命中，延迟降低241ms。
summary.en: Leyline introduces serving-side KV cache directives for agentic inference. Chatbot workloads assume append-only cache growth, but agentic LLMs evolve via policy editing: retried tools, dropped outputs, pivoted...

items.title: 3DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agentic Procedural 3D Modeling Via Code

summary.zh: 3DCodeBench评估VLM Agent在3D建模软件中的程序生成能力。通过代码进行程序化3D建模提供确定性、引擎就绪的资产。该基准评测12个高级VLM将文本/图像参考转换为程序代码的能力。3DCodeArena基于人类偏好对的排名平台提供感知质量评估。发现主要失败来自API不匹配，成功渲染仍有几何组件断裂。发布包含多模态提示、程序代码、3D对象三元组的大规模数据集。
summary.en: 3DCodeBench systematically evaluates VLM agents for procedural 3D generation via code in 3D modeling software. Procedural modeling offers deterministic, engine-ready assets lacking in neural generators. Tests 12...

items.title: ExpWeaver: LLM Agents Learn from Experience via Latent RAG

summary.zh: ExpWeaver通过隐空间RAG使LLM Agent从经验学习。现有方法限于显式文本空间，通过语义相似性检索导致大量令牌开销。ExpWeaver使用LLM自身隐状态编码经验，在解码每步直接在隐空间检索相关经验，通过交叉注意聚合和门控残差机制集成。端到端强化学习优化，支持生成和排名任务。在13项多样任务上达到最高性能，令牌效率显著优于文本检索。
summary.en: ExpWeaver enables LLM agents to learn from experience via latent retrieval-augmented generation. Existing text-based methods retrieve experiences semantically and concatenate to context, causing token overhead and...

items.title: Bridging Requirements and Architecture: Multi-Agent Orchestration with External Knowledge and Hierarchical Memory

summary.zh: MAAD（多Agent架构设计）框架用知识驱动的Agent编排自动化软件架构设计。通过四个专化Agent（分析员、建模者、设计者、评估者）协作将需求转换为多视图架构蓝图。整合RAG注入架构标准和模式，采用层级记忆机制捕获设计历史。与MetaGPT对比在10个案例研究中，MAAD生成更完整、模块化、可追溯的架构，模型能力（GPT-5.2、Qwen3.5）对质量有重要影响。
summary.en: MAAD (Multi-Agent Architecture Design) uses knowledge-driven Agent orchestration to automate software architecture design. Four specialized agents (Analyst, Modeler, Designer, Evaluator) collaboratively transform...

items.title: ANDES: Agent Native Data Evolving Synthesis Tool for Autonomous Instruction Alignment

summary.zh: ANDES（Agent本地数据进化合成）将数据生成重新构想为Agent技能。Agent自动化AI研究中后训练阶段面临长地平线任务中的上下文溢出。ANDES提供智能抽象层，通过自进化World Tree路由机制和可执行诊断报告，使训练Agent动态指导数据合成。在严格计算约束下，装备ANDES的较弱Agent在PostTrainBench上取得最佳性能并展现跨任务泛化能力。
summary.en: ANDES (Agent Native Data Evolving Synthesis) reimagines data generation as a plug-and-play agent skill. AI agents automating post-training face context overflow in long-horizon web-gathering tasks. ANDES provides...

items.title: HomeFlow: A Data Flywheel for Smart Home Agent Training with Verifiable Simulation

summary.zh: HomeFlow为智能家居Agent提供可验证的数据飞轮。LLM Agent超越纯文本交互朝向物理世界控制。HomeEnv统一仿真环境，HomeMaker程序化生成多样家庭设置。Blueprint将开放式用户意图编译为可执行状态条件，MCTS-Flow通过环境引导树搜索合成多样可验证多轮轨迹。SmartHome-Bench评估Agent在多种智能家居任务上表现，HomeFlow-RL-8B达87.03%任务成功率，超GPT-5.5。
summary.en: HomeFlow provides a verifiable data flywheel for smart home agent training. LLM agents move beyond text-only interaction toward physical-world control. HomeEnv serves as unified simulation; HomeMaker procedurally...

items.title: LLM Consortium for Software Design Refinement: A Controlled Experiment on Multi-Agent Collaboration Topologies

summary.zh: 在多Agent LLM软件架构设计中进行对照实验，评估12种协作拓扑。采用2×2×2因子设计（权威性×角色×动力学），8项设计任务各5次重复，共520次实验。结果显示结构化对抗型（提出重写而非补丁）排名第一，跨模型审查排名第二。并行合并拓扑全体排名底层。三个独立评估器展示评估多样性，同时确认最佳和最差选项。
summary.en: Controlled experiment evaluating 12 multi-agent LLM collaboration topologies for software architecture design. 2×2×2 factorial design (Authority × Roles × Dynamics) across 520 runs with 8 design tasks. Structural...

items.title: DrugClaw and DrugAudit: A Primary-Source-Grounded Agent and Authority-Aware Benchmark for Drug-Information Question Answering

summary.zh: DrugClaw提供多Agent检索增强系统，查询药物和药物警戒技能库。DrugAudit基准包含3,772项权威感知样本，评估上游源匹配率、令牌级语义片段重叠和引用忠实度。在多个医学QA数据集上超越所有基线：初级源率91.8%（+10.1 pp）、忠实度88.7%（+5.9 pp）。在高风险医学决策场景中通过可追溯性强调提高可靠性。
summary.en: DrugClaw provides multi-agent retrieval-augmented system querying drug and pharmacovigilance skills, returning answers grounded in primary regulatory or peer-reviewed records. DrugAudit benchmark with 3,772...

items.title: SABER: Benchmarking Operational Safety of LLM Coding Agents in Stateful Project Workspaces

summary.zh: SABER评估LLM编码Agent在有状态项目工作空间中的操作安全性。现有基准评测模型拒绝不安全提示的能力，但忽视对有状态工作空间的影响。SABER将模型置于现实Agent风格项目中，从最终环境状态评估安全性。超过54%的模型有害违规率，表明当前对齐不足。基准按原因分类违规，实现模型特定安全档案分析。
summary.en: SABER benchmarks operational safety of LLM coding agents in stateful project workspaces. Existing benchmarks assess whether models refuse unsafe prompts; impacts on stateful workspaces remain unexamined. SABER places...

items.title: Worlds Within Words: Translating Culture in Ancient Chinese Texts with Multi-Agent Coordination

summary.zh: MACAT框架用多Agent方法处理古汉语文本中的文化词汇翻译。文化词汇超越词汇对齐，需决策何时及如何为读者阐释文化依赖知识。MACAT动态识别文化显著短语，必要时注入简明解释。包含质量感知重排模块和多轮评估Agent，评估术语精确性、可读性、保真度、文化保留和文化阐释。在中医古籍和论语上，MACAT超越主干和通用基线。
summary.en: MACAT addresses culture-loaded word (CLW) translation in ancient Chinese texts. Translation extends beyond lexical alignment to deciding when and how to explicate culture-dependent knowledge for readers lacking...
